errors.network: Couldn't reach the backend. Check your connection and try again.

notFound.title: Nothing here
notFound.text: This page doesn't exist, or it moved.

setup.title: Create the first admin
setup.fromGame: Open this page from the link /allay init gave you in the game. You become the panel's owner.
setup.fromLog: Enter the setup code from the backend's log. You become the panel's owner.
setup.usernameHint: 2–32 lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes, or underscores.

errors.username: Use 2–32 lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes, or underscores.
errors.password: The password needs at least 10 characters.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to manage this Allay backend.

errors.limited: Too many failed tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: How Allay is used and what it costs. Nobody's questions or answers are shown here.
dashboard.empty: No questions in this period yet.
dashboard.modelsHint: Runs and their cost, summaries included.
dashboard.toolsHint: How often the agent called each tool, and how often the call failed.
dashboard.noTools: No tools ran in this period.

players.title: Players
players.description: Everyone who asked Allay, newest first.

player.privacy: What the player asked, what Allay remembers about them, and their session stay theirs: the panel shows only how many.
player.deleteMemoriesTitle: Delete all of this player's memories?
player.deleteMemoriesText_one: Allay forgets the {{count}} fact it keeps about this player. They can't get it back.
player.deleteMemoriesText_other: Allay forgets the {{count}} facts it keeps about this player. They can't get them back.
player.resetSessionText: Their next question starts a fresh conversation, as /ask new does. Memories stay.

servers.title: Servers
servers.description: Minecraft servers that asked, by who pays: a license, the server's own key, or this backend.

runs.title: Runs
runs.description: Each question, wake, and summary with its numbers.

run.title: Run
run.toolsHint: Which tools ran and whether they worked; never what they were given or returned.
run.noTrace: This run has no trace: traces cover a share of runs and last a few days.

traces.title: Traces
traces.description: The shape of traced runs: steps, tools, tokens, and timings. Prompts, questions, answers, and tool data never leave the backend.
traces.none: No traces. Tracing may be off (TRACE_SAMPLE), or traces have expired.

trace.title: Trace
trace.description: Each step of the run on one timeline.
trace.privacy: Model steps in blue, tool calls in green. The panel never shows what was asked or answered.

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.description: Telegram Stars payments. Dollars are estimates at {{rate}} a Star.
revenue.licenseCost: Runs on licenses cost {{usd}} so far

licenses.title: Licenses
licenses.description: Servers on a subscription, in dollars; operators see only percentages.
licenses.search: Search by id or server name
licenses.grantText: The money is there at once and lasts the given days, or to the end of what's paid if that's later.
licenses.extendText: Moves the end of the current period. The budget stays the same.
licenses.blockText: Its servers stop getting answers and can't pay until you unblock it. Operators see the subscription as inactive.
licenses.unblockText: Its servers can ask and pay again.
licenses.noServers: No questions from this license yet.
licenses.paymentsHint: A refund returns the Stars through the bot and closes what they paid for.

errors.usd: Give an amount above 0 and up to 1000.

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Every Stars payment and refund, newest first.
payments.refundText: The bot returns {{stars}} Stars to the payer, closes the period they paid for, and stops the subscription it belongs to.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Everything the backend reads besides where MongoDB and Redis live.

environment.title: From the environment
environment.description: These stay in the environment and can't change here.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model Allay answers with and the key it pays with.

search.title: Web search
search.description: How the agent searches the web on this backend's key.

limits.title: Agent limits
limits.description: How far a run may go and how long it waits.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: How long conversations live and when they fold into a summary.

tracing.title: Tracing
tracing.description: Which runs leave a trace, and for how long.

billing.title: Billing and plans
billing.description: Prices, budgets, and the limits for servers with their own key.

address.title: Public address
address.description: Where people and Telegram reach this backend.

settings.lockedHint: Remove the variable from the environment to edit it here, or import it first.

secret.broken: Stored, but the current key can't open it

settings.plansWarning: New prices and budgets apply to new payments. Periods already paid keep what they bought.
settings.saved_one: Saved {{count}} setting. It applies to the next run.
settings.saved_other: Saved {{count}} settings. They apply to the next run.

import.title: Import the environment's values?
import.text_one: {{count}} setting comes from the environment. Importing saves its value here, so you can remove the variable afterwards. Until then, the variable still wins.
import.text_other: {{count}} settings come from the environment. Importing saves their values here, so you can remove the variables afterwards. Until then, the variables still win.

errors.int: Enter a whole number in the allowed range.
errors.number: Enter a number in the allowed range.
errors.url: Enter an http or https address.
errors.pattern: This doesn't have the expected form.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Who may sign in. Owners manage accounts, admins change settings and billing, viewers only read.
accounts.addText: Give the name and password to the person yourself; they can change the password later.
accounts.rolesHint: Owner: everything. Admin: settings, players, billing. Viewer: reads only.
accounts.resetText: They're signed out everywhere and sign in with the new one.
accounts.deleteText: They're signed out at once and can't sign in again.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Who changed what and when. Secrets show only their last characters.

profile.title: Your account
profile.passwordHint: Changing it signs you out on every other device.
profile.envAccount: This account is defined by the backend's environment; change ADMIN_PASSWORD there.
